title: Confirm Medic Bridge v1.2.0 Stage 2
description: Verify the Medic Bridge extension and Docker relay are installed and operational (Stage 2 completion check).
objectives: Check Docker container 'medic-bridge' is running (docker ps) and report status/uptime
Check the relay health endpoint and report the response
Verify the Chrome extension v1.2.0 files exist in the expected location
Report whether the relay is polling its webhook bin (check logs or config)
Summarize: is Stage 2 (extension installed + relay running) complete or not
constraints: Read-only verification; do not reinstall or reconfigure
Do not modify relay tokens or config files
If components are missing, report exactly what is missing and stop
